name: Correcting A Brother
overview: Scripture instructs believers to lovingly and privately address a brother's fault with the goal of restoration, as seen in Matthew 18:15 where confrontation is encouraged between the individuals involved to regain fellowship. Galatians 6:1 emphasizes restoring the erring one with a spirit of meekness, mindful of one's own vulnerability to temptation. The epistles also caution against persistent divisiveness and heresy, urging avoidance of those who cause division (Romans 16:17) and rejection after repeated admonitions (Titus 3:10). Ultimately, James 5:19 highlights the importance of turning a brother back from error, underscoring the redemptive purpose behind correction.
